title: Nomad
description:
One glance at a map, and you can trace it from memory with a fingertip in the sand.

You remember every map you have seen in perfect detail. You always recall the general layout of any terrain, settlement or other arrangement you have glimpsed. Only magical means can lead you astray.

Each day, if the land offers anything to live on (berries, small game, a water source), you find a day's food and fresh water for yourself and for up to five other creatures whose {{taille}} is {{petite}} or {{moyenne}}.
